exercises.prompt: Select the 1st-person singular past of مَدَّ ('I extended'):
exercises.explanation: Before consonant-initial suffixes (ـْتُ), the doubled 2nd and 3rd radicals separate: مَدَدْتُ.

feedback.rule: Idghām separates whenever C3 takes sukūn.

exercises.prompt: True or False: In يَمُدُّ (3ms imperfect), the identical radicals remain contracted with shaddah.
exercises.explanation: True. Because C3 carries a vowel (ḍammah -u), the two dāls stay contracted with shaddah.

feedback.rule: Contract with shaddah whenever C3 is vowelled.
